body.text: Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra

evaṃ mayā śrutam / ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharatisma jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṅghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśarbhibhikṣuśataiḥ sambahulaiśca bodhisattvairmahāsattvaiḥ // 1 //

tatra khalu bhagavān mañjuśrīyāṃ kumārabhūtām āmantrayate sma / asti mañjuśrīrūpariṣṭāyām aparimitāguṇasañcayo nāma lokadhātustatrāparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorāja nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddha eva hi tiṣṭhati dhriyate yāpayati sattvānāṃ ca dharmaṃ deśayati // 2 //

śṛṇu mañjuśrīḥ kumārabhūtā, ime jambudvipakā manuṣyā alpāyuṣkā varṣaśatāyuṣas, teṣāṃ bahunyākālamaranāni nirdiṣṭāni / ye khalu mañjuśrīḥ sattvastasyāparimitāyuṣaḥ tathāgatasya guṇavarṇaparikīrtana nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ likhiṣyanti likhāpayiṣyanti nāmadheyamātram api śroṣyanti yāvat pustakagatām api kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti puṣpadhūpagandhamālyavilepanacūrṇacīvarachatradhvajaghaṇṭāpatākābhiśca samantāt pūjābhiḥ pūjāyiṣyanti te parikṣiṇāyuṣaḥ punaraiva varṣaśatāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti / ye khalu punarmañjuśrīḥ sattvastasyāparimitāyurjñānasuviniścita tejorājasya tathāgatasya nāmoṣṭottaraśataṃ śroṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti, teṣām āyurvadhayiṣyanti, ye parikṣiṇāyuṣaḥ sattvā nāmadheyaṃ śroṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti teṣām apyāyurvivardhayiṣyati // 3 //
tasmāttarhi mañjuśrīdirghāyuṣkatvaṃ prārthayitukāmaḥ kulaputrā vā kuladuhitaro vā tasyāparimitāyuṣastathāgatasya nāmāṣṭottaraśataṃ śroṣyanti likhiṣyanti teṣām ime guṇānusaṃsā bhaviṣyanti // 4 //

om namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya, tadyathā, om puṇyamahāpuṇya aparimitāpuṇya aparimitāyupuṇya jñānasambhāropacite, om sarvasaṃskāra pariśuddhadharmate gagaṇasamudgate svabhāvapariśuddhe mahānayāparivāre svāhā // 5 //

imāṃ mañjuśrīstathāgatasya nāmoṣṭottaraśataṃ ye kecil likhiṣyanti likhāpayiṣyanti pustakagatām api kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti, te parikṣīṇāyuṣaḥ punaraiva varṣaśatāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti, itaścutvā aparimitāyuṣastathāgatasya buddhakṣetre upapadyante, aparimitāyuṣaśca bhaviṣyanti aparimitāguṇasañcaye lokadhātau // 6 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena navanavatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 7 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena caturaśītīnāṃ Buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 8 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena saptasaptatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 9 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena pañcaṣaṣṭīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 10 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena pañcapañcaśatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 11 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena pañcacatvāriśatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 12 //
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena ṣaṭtriṃśatīnāṃ Buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 13 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. At that time, thirty-six <s>koṭis</s> (tens of millions) of <s>Buddhas</s>, with one accord and one voice, spoke this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> (Sūtra of Immeasurable Life). (13)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena pañcaviṃśatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 14 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. At that time, twenty-five <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddhas</s>, with one accord and one voice, spoke this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s>. (14)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena gaṅgānadīvālukopamānāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam // 15 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. At that time, <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddhas</s> equal in number to the grains of sand in the river <s>Gaṅgā</s>, with one accord and one voice, spoke this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s>. (15)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati sa na kadācinnarakeṣūpapadyate na tīryagyonau na yamaloke na akṣaṇeṣu ca kadācid api upapasyate / yatra yatra janmanyupapadyate, tatra tatra sarvatra jātau jātau jātismaro bhaviṣyanti // 17 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — that person will never be reborn in the hells, nor in the animal realm, nor in the world of <s>Yama</s>, nor will they ever be reborn in unfavorable conditions. In whatever birth they are reborn, in every single birth they will possess the memory of past lives. (17)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati tena caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasrāṇi likhāpitāni bhaviṣyanti // 18 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — by that person, eighty-four thousand collections of <s>Dharma</s> (<s>dharmaskandhas</s>) will have been caused to be written. (18)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati tena caturaśītidharmarājikāsahasrāṇi kārāpitāni pratiṣṭhāpitāni bhaviṣyanti // 19 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — by that person, eighty-four thousand <s>dharmarājikā</s> (Dharma-reliquary shrines) will have been caused to be built and established. (19)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati tasya pañcānantaryāṇi karmāvaraṇāni parikṣayaṃ gacchanti // 20 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — for that person, the five uninterrupted <s>karmic</s> obstructions (<s>ānantarya</s>) will be exhausted. (20)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati, tasya na māro na mārakāyikā na yakṣa na rākṣasā nākālamṛtyurevatāraṃ lapsyante // 22 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — neither <s>Māra</s>, nor the hosts of <s>Māra</s>, nor <s>yakṣas</s>, nor <s>rākṣasas</s>, nor untimely death will find an opportunity against that person. (22)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati, tasya maraṇakālasamaye navanavatayo buddhakoṭyaḥ sammukhaṃ darśanaṃ dāsyanti, buddhasahasraṃ hastena hastaṃ tasyopanāmayanti, Buddhakṣetrādbuddhakṣetraṃ saṅkrāmati, nātra kāṅkṣā na vicikitsā na vimātirutpādayitavyā // 23 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — at the time of that person's death, ninety-nine <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddhas</s> will grant their visible appearance face-to-face, a thousand <s>Buddhas</s> will extend hand to hand to that person, and they will pass from <s>Buddha</s>-field to <s>Buddha</s>-field. In this there should be no doubt, no uncertainty, no hesitation. (23)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati, tasya catvāro mahārājānaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanubaddha rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyanti // 24 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — the Four Great Kings (<s>Caturmahārājānaḥ</s>) will follow closely behind that person and provide protection, shelter, and guardianship. (24)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati sa sukhāvatyāṃ lokadhātau amitābhasya tathāgatasya buddhakṣetre upapadyate // 25 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — that person will be reborn in the world-realm <s>Sukhāvatī</s> (the Land of Bliss), in the <s>Buddha</s>-field of the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Amitābha</s>. (25)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati, sa pṛthivīpradeśaḥ caityabhūto vandanīyaśca bhaviṣyati / yeṣāṃ tiryagyonigatānāṃ mṛgapakṣīnāṃ karṇapuṭe nipatiṣyati te sarve anuttarāyāṃ samyak sambodhau abhisambodhim abhisambhotsyante // 26 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — that spot of earth will become a <s>caitya</s> (sacred shrine) worthy of veneration. For those beings born in animal realms — beasts and birds — into whose ears it falls, they will all attain perfect and complete awakening in unsurpassed, perfect <s>samyak-saṃbodhi</s>. (26)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati tasya strībhāvo na kadācid api bhaviṣyati // 27 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will write or cause to be written this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> — for that person, female rebirth will never occur. (27)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ dharmaparyāyam uddiśya ekam api kārṣāpaṇaṃ dānaṃ dāsyati, tena trisāhasramahāsāhasralokadhātuṃ saptaratnaparipūrṇaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dattaṃ bhavati // 28 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever, with reference to this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> as a <s>dharmaparyāya</s> (Dharma-discourse), gives even a single <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> (coin) as a gift — by that person, a gift has been given equal to filling the entire three-thousand-great-thousand world-system (<s>trisāhasramahāsāhasralokadhātu</s>) with the seven precious substances. (28)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam dharmabhāṇakaṃ pūjayiṣyati, tena sakalasamāptaḥ saddharmaḥ pūjito bhavati // 29 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. Whoever will honor this preacher of the <s>Dharma</s> (<s>dharmabhāṇaka</s>) — by that person, the entire holy <s>Dharma</s> in its completeness has been honored. (29)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / yathā vipaśviśikhiviśvabhukrakucchandakanakamunikāśyapaśākyamuniprabhṛtīnāṃ tathāgatānāṃ saptaratnamayaḥ pūjāḥ kṛtvā tasya puṇyaskandhasya pramāṇaṃ śakyaṃ gaṇayituṃ, na tvāparimitāyuḥ sūtrasya puṇyaskandhasya pramāṇaṃ śakyaṃ gaṇayitum // 30 //
body.translated_text: Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One. It is possible to measure the mass of merit from making offerings of the seven precious substances to the <s>Tathāgatas</s> such as <s>Vipaśvin</s>, <s>Śikhin</s>, <s>Viśvabhuj</s>, <s>Krakucchanda</s>, <s>Kanakamuni</s>, <s>Kāśyapa</s>, <s>Śākyamuni</s>, and others; but it is not possible to measure the mass of merit from the <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s>. (30)

body.text: om namo bhagavate / yathā sumeroḥ parvatarājasya samānāṃ ratnarāśiṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dadyāt, tasya puṇyaskandhasya pramāṇaṃ śakyaṃ gaṇayituṃ, na tvāparimitāyuḥ sūtrasya puṇyaskandhasya pramāṇaṃ śakyaṃ gaṇayitum // 31 //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One). Just as one were to amass a heap of jewels equal to <s>Sumeru</s>, king of mountains, and give it as a gift — the measure of that mass of merit could be calculated, but the measure of the mass of merit of the <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> cannot be calculated. // 31 //

body.text: om namo bhagavate / yathā catvāro mahāsamudrā udakaparipūṇṇā bhaveyuḥ, tatra ekaikavinduṃ śakyaṃ gaṇayituṃ, na tvāparimitāyuḥ sūtrasya puṇyaskandhasya pramāṇaṃ śakyaṃ gaṇayitum // 32 //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Just as the four great oceans were filled with water — therein, each single drop could be counted, but the measure of the mass of merit of the <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s> cannot be calculated. // 32 //

body.text: om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati saṃskṛtya pūjayiṣyati tena daśasu dikṣu sarvabuddhakṣetreṣu sarvatathāgatā vanditāḥ pūjitāśca bhaviṣyanti // 33 //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Whoever will write this <s>Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra</s>, or cause it to be written, and having prepared it, will worship it — by that [act], all <s>Tathāgatas</s> in all <s>buddhakṣetras</s> (buddha-fields) in the ten directions will have been venerated and worshipped. // 33 //

children.translated_text: By the power of <s>dāna</s> (generosity) the <s>Buddha</s> has arisen; by the power of generosity the Lion among Men has been attained;

children.text: dānabalasya ca śrūyati śabda kāruṇikasya pure praviśantaṃ // 34 //
children.translated_text: and the sound of the power of generosity is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. // 34 //
By the power of <s>śīla</s> (moral conduct) the <s>Buddha</s> has arisen; by the power of moral conduct the Lion among Men has been attained;

children.text: śīlabalasya ca śrūyati śabda kāruṇikasya pure praviśantaṃ // 35 //
children.translated_text: and the sound of the power of moral conduct is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. // 35 //
By the power of <s>kṣānti</s> (patience) the <s>Buddha</s> has arisen; by the power of patience the Lion among Men has been attained;

children.text: kṣāntibalasya ca śrūyati śabda kāruṇikasya pure praviśantaṃ // 36 //
children.translated_text: and the sound of the power of patience is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. // 36 //
By the power of <s>vīrya</s> (effort) the <s>Buddha</s> has arisen; by the power of effort the Lion among Men has been attained;

children.text: vīryabalasya ca śrūyati śabda kāruṇikasya pure praviśantaṃ // 37 //
children.translated_text: and the sound of the power of effort is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. // 37 //
By the power of <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation) the <s>Buddha</s> has arisen; by the power of meditation the Lion among Men has been attained;

children.text: dhyānabalasya ca śrūyati śabda kāruṇikasya pure praviśantaṃ // 38 //
children.translated_text: and the sound of the power of meditation is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. // 38 //
By the power of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom) the <s>Buddha</s> has arisen; by the power of wisdom the Lion among Men has been attained;

children.text: prajñābalasya ca śrūyati śabda kāruṇikasya pure praviśantaṃ // 39 //
children.translated_text: and the sound of the power of wisdom is heard as the Compassionate One enters the city. // 39 //

body.text: om namo bhagavate / idam vocadbhagavān āttamanaste ca bhikṣavaste ca bodhisattva mahāsattvaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandanam iti // 40 //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Thus spoke the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Those delighted <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), those <s>bodhisattva-mahāsattvas</s> (great bodhisattva beings), and that entire assembly together with the world of <s>devas</s> (gods), humans, <s>asuras</s>, and <s>gandharvas</s> — all rejoiced at the words of the <s>Bhagavān</s>. // 40 //
